narr: Elsa made landfall as a strong tropical storm across the southeast big bend of Florida on July 7th. Impacts included several trees and power lines blown down along with coastal flooding from storm surge and flash flooding from heavy rainfall. Flash flooding and gusty winds also impacted portions of south central Georgia.
ev: A few dirt roads were washed out in southern Lowndes county due to heavy rain from Tropical Storm Elsa.
Flooding was reported on San Bernadino Way due to heavy rain from Tropical Storm Elsa.
US Highway 41 south of Lake Park was closed due to flash flooding from Tropical Storm Elsa.
